## Triage Checklist (for maintainers)
- [ ] Fits product vision
- [ ] Aligns with Agent-First Philosophy
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Cost implications reviewed (AI usage, infrastructure)
- [ ] Added to Phase 2/3 roadmap
- [ ] Labeled with scope (PR-1 | PR-3 | PR-5 | dashboard | agents | docs)

## Handoff to Agents
@copilot If this is a **well-scoped feature** (<400 LOC, clear requirements), please:
1. Create implementation plan
2. Check for conflicts with existing code
3. Estimate LOC and complexity
4. Propose architecture (if >100 LOC)
5. Create feature branch and PR if approved

If this requires product decisions or affects architecture, request human review.
